claims.rationale: The latest 8-K (filed 2026-11-12) confirms the claim's premise: Huang resigned as CEO and director, effective immediately. The filings do not support the inference that his departure is a reason to buy. They show an interim CEO who still serves as CFO, an open CEO search, and strong financial results achieved under Huang. The claim's factual basis holds, but its investment logic is unsupported by these passages.
claims.caution: The evidence for this verdict was filed before the 8-K of 12 Nov 2026 (Item 5.02), which reports a change of directors or officers. Read that filing before relying on the verdict.

claims.text: Data center revenue is still growing
queries: Data Center revenue decrease export controls China
claims.rationale: The 10-K explicitly reports strong fiscal 2026 growth in Data Center computing and networking revenue. Total revenue growth in the two most recent quarters accelerated further, and revenue is concentrated in Compute & Networking, which indirectly supports continued Data Center growth. The main counterweight in the passages is China foreclosure and export-control risk.

findings.statement: The factual premise that Jensen Huang is gone is supported by the most recent filing. An 8-K filed 2026-11-12 reports that on November 11, 2026 the Board accepted Huang's resignation as President, CEO and director, effective immediately. This supersedes the earlier 10-K, which listed him as CEO as of February 20, 2026.
findings.rationale: The 8-K is the latest filing and explicitly reports the resignation. The older 10-K passages naming Huang as CEO predate it and do not settle the question.

checks.support_detail: The Item 5.02 excerpt states the Board accepted Huang's resignation as President, CEO and director effective immediately on November 11, 2026, directly supporting the premise that he is gone; it does not mention the 8-K date or the 10-K supersession, which are minor extras.

findings.statement: Leadership after the departure is interim and unresolved. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while the Board searches for a permanent CEO, and she keeps her CFO role at the same time. The filings do not show that the departure itself improves the investment case.
findings.rationale: An interim CEO who also remains CFO, plus an open CEO search, points to transition uncertainty rather than a clear positive catalyst. Whether this is good or bad for the stock is a judgement, so confidence is medium.

checks.support_detail: Excerpts show Kress is interim CEO while a search continues and she remains CFO, supporting the interim point; but nothing in the excerpts addresses whether the departure does or does not improve the investment case, which is an opinion-level remark rather than a filing fact.

findings.statement: Huang co-founded the company and led it as CEO from its inception. In the most recent quarter reported before his exit (ended 2026-07-26), revenue was $96.22B, up 105.9% year over year, with a 75.0% gross margin. This is strong performance under his leadership, which cuts against the idea that his departure is itself a reason to buy.
findings.rationale: The figures show strong results during Huang's tenure. That does not prove his departure is negative, but it weakens the argument that removing him is a positive.

checks.support_detail: Excerpts confirm Huang co-founded and led as CEO and the figures show strong revenue, growth and margin, but the figures are not tied to his leadership and the excerpts do not establish causation; the stance against buying on departure is an inference.

findings.statement: Other leadership changes happened around the same time. Harvey C. Jones, a director since 1993, was named Board Chair. Earlier in 2026, EVP of Worldwide Field Operations Ajay Puri announced his retirement and Nicholas Parker was appointed as his successor.
findings.rationale: These passages describe broader senior turnover that matters for judging leadership stability, but they neither support nor challenge the buy thesis directly.

checks.support_detail: The excerpts report Harvey Jones appointed Board Chair with a 1993 board start and Nicholas Parker appointed as EVP Worldwide Field Operations in July 2026, matching the context claim; the Ajay Puri retirement is not in the excerpts, so that part is unverified.

findings.statement: In fiscal year 2026, Data Center computing revenue grew 59% driven by Blackwell demand, and Data Center networking revenue grew 142%.
findings.rationale: This is a direct MD&A statement of year-over-year Data Center revenue growth for the most recent fiscal year shown. It is annual, though, not the latest quarter.

checks.support_detail: The excerpt states Data Center computing revenue grew 59% driven by Blackwell demand and networking grew 142%, matching the statement and supporting continued growth in data center revenue.

findings.rationale: This is a headwind to Data Center growth, but the passages do not show that it has stopped growth.

checks.support_detail: The excerpt says NVIDIA was effectively foreclosed from China's data center compute market, which bears on data center revenue; the challenge stance is appropriate, though the statement's specific impact warnings are not shown in the excerpt.

brief.summary: Both claims show mixed evidence. Claim 1: Jensen Huang has left. An 8-K dated 2026-11-12 reports the Board accepted his resignation as President, CEO and director on November 11, 2026. But leadership is now interim, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO while also staying CFO. The filings do not show that his exit helps the case. In the last quarter before he left, revenue was $96.22B, up 105.9%, at a 75.0% gross margin. Claim 2: In fiscal 2026, Data Center computing revenue grew 59% and networking grew 142%. However, NVIDIA says it is effectively shut out of China's data center market and expects a material adverse impact. Neither premise alone justifies buying now.
unknowns: The reasons for Huang's resignation, and whether it is linked to any company issue
Who the permanent CEO will be and how long the search will take
Market reaction and the current valuation, which are not in the passages
Any change in strategy, guidance or results after the departure
Whether Huang keeps any advisory role or shareholding influence
Data Center revenue figures for the fiscal 2027 quarters (ended 2026-04-26 and 2026-07-26) are not in the passages.
Absolute Data Center revenue dollar amounts are not given.
Sequential (quarter-over-quarter) Data Center growth is not shown.
Forward guidance or backlog for Data Center is not provided.
next_steps: Track the Board's permanent CEO search, including the timeline, candidates and any 8-K updates on Kress's dual role.
Review the next 10-Q for Data Center revenue trends after the leadership change and the loss of China.
Quantify how much Data Center revenue historically came from China to size the impact of being foreclosed.
Check for executive departures, guidance changes or customer commentary following Huang's resignation.

opening: On June 28, 2026, Ajay K. Puri, Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations of NVIDIA Corporation, or the Company, notified the Company of his intention to retire from his role effective upon the employment commencement date of his successor.
Mr. Puri, a 21-year executive at NVIDIA, is expected to remain with the Company in a senior advisory role to ensure a seamless transition to his successor.

items.locator: Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers
opening: On May 7, 2026, the Board of Directors, or the Board, of NVIDIA Corporation appointed Suzanne Nora Johnson as a member of the Board and as a member of the Audit Committee of the Board and the number of directors constituting the full Board was increased from ten to eleven, in each case effective July 13, 2026.
Ms. Nora Johnson will join the Board effective July 13, 2026, due to a prior professional commitment.

items.locator: Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers
opening: On April 24, 2026, Donald Robertson, Vice President, or VP, and Chief Accounting Officer, or CAO, of NVIDIA Corporation, or the Company, notified the Company of his intention to retire from his role as VP and CAO, effective May 4, 2026.
Following such date, he will remain with the Company as VP, Finance to support various projects until July 1, 2026.

items.locator: Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers
opening: On March 2, 2026, the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors, or the Board, of NVIDIA Corporation, or the Company, adopted the Variable Compensation Plan for Fiscal Year 2027, or the 2027 Plan, which provides eligible executive officers the opportunity to earn a variable cash payment based on the level of achievement by the Company of certain corporate performance goals, or the Performance Goals, during fiscal year 2027.
The Company operates on a fiscal year ending on the last Sunday in January and designates its fiscal year by the year in which that fiscal year ends.
